title: Q-ROOT-unclassified: unclassified keeps recurring: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified
**Status:** open

Root cause class `unclassified` recurred on 6 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: no root-cause class explains this finding
Guard: `file:doctrine/rootcauses.json`
Remedy: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:clock-measured: clock-measured a loop's clock has no reading in the published record (no route that can read its beats from this host) c
- failure-audit:code-agent-ladder: code-agent-ladder no code-agent rung returns an answer (credential without the permission, provider answering 200 with n
- failure-audit:content-drift: content-drift a system's feed is unreadable or its newest entries are empty, cut off, templated or repeated ions-baryon-
- failure-audit:cost-runaway: cost-runaway the cost reading stopped, was unmeasured, or a free-plan limit is near latest cost reading measured no D1 d
- failure-audit:d1-growth: d1-growth a database's measured growth reaches the size limit inside the horizon latest cost reading measured no D1 data
- failure-audit:dg-empty-commits: dg-empty-commits a bot commits without comparing trees a loop pushing a tree equal to its parent; MERGENOW-NOOP-1)
x ref
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified
